name: rc-local-server
description: Local RPC/asset server + live request dashboard for Restaurant City (game.swf)

scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.admin.json
scripts.check: prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.admin.json --noEmit
scripts.start: npm run db:push && npm run build && node dist/server.js
